body:
Third Time's the charm.
I'm a 19 year old male with a fair bit of psychedelic experience and have been interested in tryptamines for awhile, so I figured I'd give this a shot as this is my third time taking 4-HO-MiPT, first two trips went very well.
Substance is a very fine light beige powder with a strong metallic taste. Intent of this trip was to test the bounds of a 40mg dose, as previous 20 and 25 mg doses were very tolerable. Relatively empty stomach, drinking plenty of water.
- Capsule ingested at 10:15pm.
10:15 - Bottoms up
10:38 - Nothing yet, smoking ceremonial bowl of herb topped with hash
10:45 - Onset of body load, uncomfortable knot in stomach but nothing too bad
11:00 - Higher body load, hightened hearing senses, wood grain in hardwood floor starting to
pulse and flow a little bit, little bit shakey.
11:03 - Body temp went up for sure. Wicked munchies from bowl.
11:10 - Low blood sugar, drank a couple glasses of OJ and made some sandwiches
Cutting cheese is hard when the marble of the cheese is moving,,,,
11:27 - Food preparation complete, still have an appetite.
11:32 - Meat tastes weird.
11:38 - Desire to eat is being obscured by how distracted I am at my computer
11:44 - Ate one sandwich and am full. Organizing music library...
11:46 - Slight upper back pain, tight neck muscles, restlessness.
11:51 - Body load lightened, slight head buzz, all senses are noticeably more attentive
12:00 - Stuffy sinuses I associate with this drug lately, also spring allergies may be a factor
12:04 - Tingling sensation in my gums, body load is back but just on my chest this time.
12:08 - Listening to some Tame Impala, starting to enter space
12:12 - More OJ, pupils somewhat dilated, slight nausea.
I know the trip has begun because I can really feel the vibe of the music I'm listening to
connect with my soul and start to take me on a journey as my vision gets really odd, almost like
everything is vibrating ever so slightly, heavily textured surfaces almost seem to flow in a pool of
their own colour.
12:17 - All the brushstrokes of a painting in my room are moving
12:20 - One word. Hyperawareness.
12:34 - Mild body load, phone is getting squiggly,
12:55 - General sensation of discomfort
1:22  - Body lightened, floor still moving, not feeling what I had anticipated.
1:38  - Baked and hydrated, pretty high, mild distortion in everything, very tingley and touchey.
Going to lay down with headphones in the dark for a bit, see where the visuals take me.
2:00  - Tripping pretty hard in the light of the itunes visualizer, some crazy shit happens in my pereferal
vision or something, like everything I'm not looking at is melting?
everything is vibrating pretty good now, a gulp of water drops me in the ocean for a second,
all my vision is like a drop on a still pond, and the tracers have started.....
2:10  - pereferal vision very very distorted, many uncomfortable feelings, sinister beings in the distance?
2:14  - Note to self: 'Zeus' playlist in iTunes is very powerful.
2:23  - Ragequit antichamber, very weird close visuals, something weird on my right side.
2:27  - Really close visuals, odd body load. I must be close to the spark. All movement is still weird...
2:35  - Tripping hard.
2:40  - man
if you take a picture of your face
and stare back at it
you're high
2:45: - It seems as if between the mirror and looking at a picture of myself accelerated the trip rather quickly, OEV's are abundant both in the dark and in a lit room.
3:00  - From here onwards I tried to lay in bed with some music in, but the visuals just microns away from my face are too intense, too weird. I tried to come back to update the report but it almost seems as if the trip has a mind of its own, and it would steer my into and away from doing things by filling my pereferal vision with some seemingly hostile hallicinations.
40mg was a good sized dose, definetly not unmanageable, but not something someone new to psychedelics should attempt to take unless they have a firm grasp on what is real.
Trip rated at a [++] simply due to the OEV's and how strong they were, body load wasn't too bad either.
4HO-MiPT is a nice drug I can typically control quite well from what I've experienced, but it seems as if
this rather spectacular 40mg dose was not as easy to pilot through space as I'd anticipated.
this rather spectacular 40mg dose was not as easy to pilot through space as I'd anticipated.
I kept well hydrated and focused less on being high and more on what the trip revealed to me.
- Nothing That Has Happened So Far Has Been Anything We Could Control
